decision.llm_reasoning: The course focuses on B2C e-commerce sales rather than B2B e-procurement systems.

evidence.text: This course provides students with in-depth knowledge and practical skills in developing e-commerce applications on the WordPress platform. The course content focuses on the design and construction process of popular website types: from professional news sites to fully featured online sales systems. Through the course, students can master the CMS system, independently customize professional interfaces, and set up commercial processes from inventory management to automated payment configuration with WooCommerce.

The course equips students with advanced knowledge and practical skills on the WordPress platform to build popular types of websites in e-commerce. Students are capable of deploying everything from professional news sites to fully-featured integrated online sales systems.
Understanding the WordPress ecosystem: Mastering the open-source code structure, and the operational mechanisms of Themes and Plugins.
Mastering the design process: Understanding content presentation principles for news sites and the structure of an SEO-standard E-commerce website.
Understanding WooCommerce: Explaining the management process of products, orders, inventory, and online payment/shipping methods.
Knowledge of security and optimization: Understanding basic website security methods and page load speed optimization techniques for e-commerce sites.
Designing sales systems: Professionally configuring WooCommerce tools to create online stores integrated with auxiliary news.
Multi-channel integration: Connecting the website with analytics tools (Google Analytics), maps, and supporting sales affiliate tools.
System Administration: Having the ability to deploy websites from a practice environment to the internet (Hosting/Domain) and manage data storage.
Commercial Operations: Knowing how to manage product categories, process orders, and handle customer feedback professionally.
Having the ability to self-search and install new solutions to meet the changing demands of the e-commerce market.
Apply technology knowledge and principles of content management systems to rapidly deploy e-commerce sales websites.
Overview of E-commerce and WordPress Installation
Building an E-commerce Website with WooCommerce
